**What were you doing?**
(e.g. "Full run on a folder of .czi files", which menu choice, Mac or Windows)

**What happened?**
(the message you saw; a screenshot is welcome)

**Error report**
Please attach the file `error_report_<date-time>.txt` from `<your folder>_pipeline/logs/`
(drag it into this box). It contains no images, but it does contain file names and folder
paths - remove anything you don't want to share publicly.

**Version**
(first line printed when the launcher starts, e.g. "scope2fig 1.4.0", or the `VERSION` file)
